summary: This Form 8-K reports the closing of an ABS issuance by GM Financial Consumer Automobile Receivables Trust 2026-3, with AFS SenSub Corp. as depositor and AmeriCredit Financial Services as sponsor. The Issuing Entity issued $1.01579 billion in asset-backed notes across multiple tranches and a certificate on July 15, 2026. The filing satisfies an undertaking to file validity and tax opinions from counsel at takedown. This is a routine shelf takedown in the ordinary course of securitization financing, not a special situation event. No strategic change, acquisition, divestiture, or other corporate action is involved.
